rapport_notes: Genuinely caring tone throughout ('I'm just a girl too'), validated the mom's worry about her daughter lifting heavy furniture.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real worry — "I just worry about that drive from south Austin to here... it's gonna take more than two and a half hours is what I fear." Rep gave one reassurance ("our movers try to use the quickest route") and moved on — one layer, no further digging.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Not delivered — call ends at minimum-price confirmation with no self-prep tip, window framing, or fairness check.

top_strength: Caught and gently addressed the mother's underlying anxiety about her daughter attempting the move alone, building real trust in the process.
coaching_note: The drive-time worry deserved a second layer ('what else concerns you about the timing?') instead of one reassurance and a pivot back to pricing mechanics.
